tone: professional but written like a practicing engineer sharing real experience, not a marketing brochure
structure_guidance: Cover, in order: (1) a real-world problem or pain point this addresses, (2) brief context on the approach or technology, (3) a concrete use case or scenario where this applies, (4) a clear takeaway of why it matters. Do not just describe a feature in the abstract.
notes: 2026-07-21: First draft was only 27 words and read like a bare feature description with no context. Needs real-world problem framing, background, and a concrete use case, not just 'X offers Y'.
